reviews.comment: Took Math 171 with him, by far the best professor I have ever had. He makes a genuine effort to get to know all his students, and his lectures are actually engaging and not just reading off of a slide. If you ever have the chance to take a class with Dr. Weeks, please do!!

Dr. Weeks was my interim professor after my professor took a leave of absence. He took the time to learn every student's name and genuinely cared about how we were doing. His quizzes were rather difficult, but they prepare you well for the exams. He has a lot of helpful demonstrations for understanding how the formulas work. Take him!

I didn't appreciate him enough when I was in his class. He really does an amazing job of breaking down the material and having reasonable expectations. Very few surprises. I will say he's VERY positive and excited every class which was the opposite of my personality so sometimes I was a little thrown by that, but overall his positivity is nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lecture is very important. The notes are very helpful, but you need to be in class to fill them out and understand the subject. Great and caring professor; is strict with attendance.

Weeks was thrown into my section right after the second midterm when my original professor went on leave. Despite this, he did very well given the circumstances. I don't know how or why he is so happy, but it's iconic. He encourages questions to ensure we fully understand the material. His quizzes are a bit rushed, but his exams are very fair.
Definitely caring and has many helpful analogies and different ways to explain topics.

Very kind and explains concepts very well so you truly understand rather than just memorize. Only complaint is that exams make up 80% of your final grade, quizzes 10%, and mcqs on the exams are worth 5 pts, so there's not room for mistakes on the exams. The material is not too difficult to understand and it's overall really enjoyable.

Absolute GOAT of the math department at TAMU. I had the privilege of taking Linear Algebra with Dr. Weeks. He took the time to get to know everyone's name and made sure to check in on all of his students. He is an inspirational lecturer and a wonderful instructor for linear algebra. If he is listed, TAKE HIM!

Everyone know how hard 409 is, it's notorious. But despite that, Dr. Weeks made it accessible, engaging, and fun. Honestly the best professor I've had in the Math department when it comes to actually teaching course material.

This class is HARD, but the professor is such an amazing person. He is always in a good mood and is eager to help students when needed. He interacts with the class frequently and takes time to get to know students individually before class starts.

Professor Weeks is absolutely one of the best professors on campus. He does everything on his end to ensure his students have the best possible chance of succeeding. Your success on the class depends on the effort you put in. There are iClicker questions each class for a grade, so keep that in mind.
Overall, he is a very high quality professor.
None of my friends nor me got higher than a C
I missed a take home quiz due to covid (even had a dr excuse) and he told me "well i drop the lowest grade," but i scored a 35 on an exam so i was cooked

John Weeks is the best professor I have had at A&M. He truly cares about his students and makes the effort to get to know each one personally by name. He made me look forward to coming to class, even at 10am. I will say, there's SO much homework, and it's easy to fall behind. He is however, very lenient, when it comes to grading, and gives points.

High energy professor, made coming to lecture great. He really cares about his students, and would even drop inspirational speeches before exams that rival Optimus Prime and Captain America. Very lenient grader, and he always looks to ensure that students succeed. Super chill and understanding guy too! Definitely take him.

John is easily the best professor I've ever had. He brings enthusiasm and passion to every class. Go to his office hours. He holds two 2 hour long sessions every week, and you can usually complete the homework during those sessions. They're also just really chill and everyone has a great time. If John is available as a professor, take the class!

This is my 2nd time taking MATH 304, trolled 1st time. But John Week is the goat for MATH courses. The way he explains concepts help you chunk the content piece by piece and conceptually. He reminds me a lot like math teachers in high school and he even gives out candy. Always a positive attitude. Workload is very doable. Take him when you can.
Great prof and great lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Weeks is one of if not the best professor I've had in college. Great at explaining complex topics and gives very fair exams. Additionally, the homework load is very light and manageable. Using practice exams is the best way to study and do well as the exams reflect what you will see on these practices. Again, cannot recommend him enough!

If you don't have him, I feel bad for you. Best prof ever. Really, really cares. Super accessible outside class, excellent at making concepts understood, super knowledgeable, very involved, borderline hyper engaged, lovable, etc. Offers partial credit for ANYTHING as long as you explain what you know. Great office hours; learned everything there.

Competent and personally invested in success. He isn't a harsh or an easy grader; he's fair. He offers partial credit for ANYTHING on tests, even multiple choice, as long as you explain as much as you know. GREAT office hours; very helpful. Very energetic. Attendance not graded, but sometimes does iClicker. Energetic; cares about your success. 100%

Absolutely the best math professor. He genuinely cares about his students and makes sure everyone understands what is going on.  If you ever don't know understand, you can find him outside of class and he will work with you.

Absolutely cares about his students and is super funny! I love how he explains problems and teaches, it's very obvious he loves his job! He gives really good feedback if you ask and walks you through any questions you may have!

HE IS AMAZING!!! Best professor I have had by far he tries his best to explain everything thoroughly and his office hours are so helpful. Attendance is not mandatory but you should go because his lectures are very helpful and he does some iclickers as a grade. He writes his tests very straight forward and the final replaces the lowest exam grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Weeks is Awesome! He is a very caring guy and loves to see his students succeed. There is a textbook but it is accessible online. Attendance isn't mandatory but there would be weekly homework online and in person weekly quizzes (maybe one or two take home) , but lectures consisted of him going over problems in the book.

Definitely the best choice for MATH 140. He is so sweet and passionate about his students succeeding, which makes for many practice materials and opportunities for the 3 exams + 1 final. iClickers were used often and taken for a grade, so make sure you show up for those. Homework and video quizzes/notes due often, but nothing was too time consuming

Professor Weeks was a phenomenal professor. His lectures were the best math lectures I have ever attended and explanations were crystal clear. Grading was always clear and tests were fairly easy. As long as you attended lectures both homework and tests were exceedingly straightforward. The best lecturer for this course and likely most others.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Weeks is the best math prof I have had at A&M. He deeply cares about his students' well being and genuinely loves the material he teaches. He creates such a positive learning environment and makes for really awesome and engaging lectures. I actually had so much fun with this class. Definitely study though! Some pretty challenging topics.

Very genuine professor. Shows true interest in the material, and is able to get you just as excited as he is to be there. No serious reliance on textbooks, but have them to reference and get practice problems if you need. He has a deep understanding of the material and can answer any question you may have. Ask questions and get feedback on work.

One of the best! Amazing lectures, breaks down concepts well, is accessible and helpful during office hours, and is generally very caring towards his students. Homework is sometimes difficult, and may need textbook and office hours help, but it helps you understand the topic. Exams are relatively easy as Dr.Weeks provides good practice materials.

I cannot recommend John Weeks enough! He is the absolute GOAT of whatever subject he teaches. He is genuinely happy to teach and loves math. His tests are super easy (like the hw) and his lectures are so good that my test prep is super minimal. If you see this man in the professor rotation, TAKE HIM!!!!

Professor Weeks is one of the best professors I've had. He consistently shows up to class early to catch up with students and answer any questions we have. If you email him, he almost always responds within 24 hours. He answers the questions you ask instead of something unrelated and is always happy to help fill in any mental gaps you may have.

It's hard to hate on professor Weeks. His jokes are sometimes corny but he tries. The class itself though was  tough. Be prepared to be spending a lot of time on this course outside of class. It is possible to earn an A in this class but requires a lot of practice and focus. He does decent in teaching the material but he can only do so much.

John is an amazing professor who really cares about his students and understands how math can be difficult for some. He answers every questions with so much repect and understanding(even the obvious ones), and always asked if he needed to reteach anything before moving on. Take him if you get the opportunity, he makes math fun and easy!
Such a good professor and person! He is so caring and funny, I wish he was teaching math 142. He does take attendance on occasions, but I would show up regardless. If you skip a lot you won't pass.
John was one of the best math teachers I've ever had. He was always so full of energy and encouraging to every student in his class.
Great lad. Smart, funny, caring. 10/10

Weeks is a chill guy but he uses way too many models in class for Calc 3 which helps you understand but does not teach you how to solve the exam. He is funny and tries to make lectures interesting but fails. Exams are mid. I studied a lot from YouTube because I stopped going to class after exam 2 and ended up doing okay.

Had him for Calc 3 in summer 2023, absolutely amazing professor. It was clear how much he really cared about every student in his class and wanted all of us to do well. His lectures were very engaging and easy to follow, even when the material got difficult. Easily one of the best math profs I've ever had, would 100% recommend taking him if you can

I took MATH 251 with Dr. Weeks in the summer of 2023. Dr. Weeks did an amazing job I love how interactive his lectures were unlike my experiences in Math 151 with Dr. Onica. Highly recommend Dr. Weeks he's very lenient and understanding just make sure to go to class and turn in your homework on time.
Best math professor I have had so far. Answers questions effectively and is very involved in class.
Awesome professor who really cares about calculus and his students. The class is relatively difficult but he puts you in a good position to succeed.

Professor Weeks brought back my love for math. Calc 3 can be a difficult class, but he made it fun and easy to understand. His office hours were helpful and he really took his time to get to know each individual student. Even if I made a mistake, he never made me feel stupid. If I could have him for every math class, I would. He was the best.

I took Prof Weeks for a semester, and honestly, he is a great person. I just don't like how condensed the last few weeks of his class was. There was homework due the day before almost all the exams and everything felt rushed when he was teaching class. Lots of videos recorded online and skipped questions in class. Take this class somewhere else.

Weeks is a very consistent professor, he always teaches with energy and care. Just study the practice tests before the exam until you ace them, if you cant, go to office hours. (its not that deep). No attendance, do your homework and you will do great.

Prof Weeks was a really nice guy and obviously cared about everyone in the class a lot. Calc 3 is a sometimes interesting sometimes boring topic, but he always tried to make it the most interesting he could. Tests are worth 80% of your grade with 10% online homework and 10% online quizzes. The tests were not bad at all just put some effort in.

Very caring and encouraging professor with incredible patience. Teaches well, no man left behind, and covered a lot of ground for how dense the class is. Literally the whole class builds up to two lectures at the end of the semester so going to class is highly recommended. Overall a king, and a good friend.

John Weeks is a good professor; he is funny and cares about his students. At the end of the semester, I did not feel like going to class just because of how fast-paced Dr. Weeks was and how boring he was. The class had a lot of homework, weekly tests, and 4 exams which were 20% each of the final grades. Avoid taking the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Weeks is probably the best math professor I've ever had at TAMU. Very good lecturer, and actually cares if you do well in his class or not. He will talk to students like friends before and after class, and is very helpful in office hours. Do yourself a favor and take him for calc 3
Such a nice professor! Very caring and has a huge love for math! Assignments are easy enough, just make sure to read carefully when taking tests.

John Weeks is one of the best options for MATH 251. He's very open to discussion with students and has a sense of humor. He makes lectures rather enjoyable to go to. He's great at explaining the content and does a ton of practice problems. He also posts the notes on Canvas if you need help.

John Weeks is by far the most caring and intentional professor I've had at A&M. He takes the time to get to know his students. He takes time to make sure everyone understands the concepts. The energy he brings to the classroom is unmatched. He inspires students so much and makes them confident in themselves.

He's super nice and cares for his students. The material itself was super easy at first but then it got harder. He will make time to help you and is very understanding. If you try, show up to lectures, ask questions, and do the homework and reviews you should be fine. The textbook was never really used unless you were looking for extra help.

Prof Weeks was my favorite professor. He managed to remember 90% of the class's names and cares about his students. The 3 exams and a final that are okay if you study a lot but he does everything he can to help you and was very understanding when something popped up. There are pop-up attendance grades and it's easy to fall behind but take him!!
He is the sweetest and most caring professor you will ever have.

He is so good at explaining lectures thoroughly and makes sure to answer all questions people have in class. He gave multiple take home quizzes and provided many office hours for us if we needed help! For the exams, he provides a lot of review material in order to do great! He also is very personable by talking to us before class and has jokes!

GOATed prof. He cares so much about his students and gives some of the most engaging lectures I've ever seen. Knows the name of 90%+ of the 80 or so students in my class. Class is quite easy, but you definitely need to study for tests. Which is made so easy because he has many review sessions and posts them to canvas. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Definitely a good professor who genuinely cares. Make sure to go to class! The exams require a lot of practice and paying attention to lectures. He gives you many opportunities to meet with him, his TAs, and reviews. Cares about you, your well being, and theres never a dumb question to ask in his class, hell make sure you understand the work.

Definitely one of my favorite professors I have ever had. Lectures are entertaining and he genuinely cares about his students and attempts to talk and relate with them. Very human and relaxed and you can easily tell he has a passion for what he teaches. Homework is not too heavy and content is not too difficult up until end of the semester w precal
You know he cares about his students! So flexible and does his best to help us out!

I LOVE THIS MAN! You can tell that he genuinely cares about his students success, and he will do his best to make sure you do well. His homework has 6 attempts/question, and he curves his exams. He also replaces your lowest exam grade with the final! HIGHLY recommend!

Professor Weeks is a great professor. He cares about all of his students and wants everyone to succeed. This class is pretty tough though with a lot of homework. He has 3 TA's with office hours and office hours himself so if you are struggling go to office hours! really good professor in my opinion and I would recommend taking him.

I LOVE HIM SO MUCH!!!!! He is a teddy bear that teaches math!!!! He wants you to succeed and he makes sure that you do. Homework is easy, and you get 6 attempts per question to get it right. I would absolutely take this class again!
Save yourself and take this class at a community college.

The worst professor I've had in my life. I'm currently a senior who has not gotten a B in a single class as a BIMS student but this guy might be the end of me. He has an hours worth work everyday like this isnt an intro level precalculus class. Don't take it with him I beg of y'all he's absolutely awful and thinks his class is ur only class.

I was pretty nervous to take business calc, but I had an amazing experience. John really cares about each and every one of his students. While exams were tougher than class work and homework, I used previous exams to study and did fine. If I had a question John was quick to respond, and he sent out helpful emails several times a week.

John is an amazing professor. He really cares about his students, and will always help 1 on 1 in office hours! Pay attention during lectures, he is quick paced. Homework was about average, it was due once a week and ranged from 10-25 problems on webassign. Not too bad tho! Absolutely loved being in his class.
